acceptance_criteria: Start from a working saved-history/pixel-edit foundation; record that named baseline in the implementation evidence.
Define clockwise/counterclockwise quarter turns, Mirror horizontal and Flip vertical with input-stage pixel coordinates, output dimensions and exact integer mappings.
Specify layer composition and history semantics for transforms before/after pixel edits; four rotations and double reflections are identity mappings.
Fixtures distinguish all axes and operation order, including EXIF-mirrored sources, odd dimensions and non-square images.

steps: Write coordinate tables and expected buffers for asymmetric 3x2/5x3 images.
Walk pixel-before-transform and pixel-after-transform cases without introducing crop or interpolation.
expected_results: Fixtures distinguish all axes and operation order, including EXIF-mirrored sources, odd dimensions and non-square images.
